{"content":"extends Node
## VitalStats: the four survival bars (Health, Hunger, Thirst, Temperature).
## The bars cross-feed:
##   hunger/thirst at 0 -> health drain (slow then fast)
##   temperature outside comfort -> health drain + move/sprint penalty
##   sprinting / hard physical work speeds up hunger+thirst drain
## Hard difficulty: resources are scarce, so drains are not gentle.

signal stats_changed
signal died
signal temp_status_changed(freezing: bool, burning: bool)

@export var max_health := 100.0
@export var max_hunger := 100.0
@export var max_thirst := 100.0

var health := 100.0
var hunger := 100.0
var thirst := 100.0

const COMFORT_MIN := 14.0
const COMFORT_MAX := 32.0
const CRITICAL_HP := 6.0

var ambient_temp := 20.0
var temp_offset := 0.0     # fire / warm clothes / cooled potion
var body_temp := 36.6
var alive := true
var freezing := false
var burning := false

var _tick := 0.0
var _hp_tick := 0.0

const HUNGER_DRAIN := 0.55      # per second, idle
const THIRST_DRAIN := 0.75      # per second, idle
const HYPO_TEMP := -8.0
const HEAT_TEMP := 46.0


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not alive:
		return
	_tick += delta
	if _tick < 1.0:
		return
	_tick -= 1.0
	# Temperature approaches the environment.
	var target := ambient_temp + temp_offset
	body_temp += (target - body_temp) * 0.12
	var in_comfort := body_temp >= COMFORT_MIN and body_temp <= COMFORT_MAX
	freezing = body_temp <= COMFORT_MIN - 3.0
	burning = body_temp >= COMFORT_MAX + 3.0
	# Drain bars.
	var activity := 1.0
	if has_method("_hard_work_multiplier") and _hard_work_multiplier() > 1.0:
		activity = _hard_work_multiplier()
	if freezing or burning:
		activity *= 1.35
	hunger = maxf(0.0, hunger - HUNGER_DRAIN * activity)
	thirst = maxf(0.0, thirst - THIRST_DRAIN * activity)
	# Empty-bar cross effects.
	if hunger <= 0.0:
		thirst = maxf(0.0, thirst - 1.2)
	if thirst <= 0.0:
		_hp_tick += 1.25
		if _hp_tick >= 2.0:
			take_damage(2.0)
			_hp_tick = 0.0
	elif _hp_tick > 0.0:
		_hp_tick = maxf(0.0, _hp_tick - 0.5)
	# Temperature damage.
	if body_temp <= HYPO_TEMP:
		take_damage(1.0)
	elif body_temp >= HEAT_TEMP:
		take_damage(1.0)
	# Partial recovery when fed & hydrated & comfortable.
	if hunger > 70.0 and thirst > 70.0 and in_comfort:
		health = minf(max_health, health + 0.35)
	stats_changed.emit()
	temp_status_changed.emit(freezing, burning)


## Called by machinery/physics systems (sprinting anchor calls this).
func exert(amount: float = 1.0) -> void:
	hunger = maxf(0.0, hunger - amount * 0.4)
	thirst = maxf(0.0, thirst - amount * 0.5)


func eat(food: float, water: float, heal: float) -> void:
	hunger = minf(max_hunger, hunger + food)
	thirst = minf(max_thirst, thirst + water)
	if heal != 0.0:
		heal = minf(0.0, heal)  # food can poison (raw meat) via negative heal
		health = maxf(0.0, health + heal)
	if food <= 0.0 and water <= 0.0:
		return
	stats_changed.emit()


func drink(water: float) -> void:
	thirst = minf(max_thirst, thirst + water)
	stats_changed.emit()


func take_damage(amount: float) -> void:
	if not alive:

	if health <= 0.0:

	health = minf(max_health, health + amount)

func set_ambient(from_world: float) -> void:

## Atomic crafting: inputs are only touched when the whole recipe (including
## required energy/temperature) can be satisfied, so nothing is ever half-made

		return false

		return false

		return false

	return true

{"content":"class_name EnergyGraphValidator
extends RefCounted
## Runtime & design-time energy graph checks. Runs every network tick and also
## once at build/design time (unit tests) to enforce:
##   - No component ever outputs more than it receives * efficiency (eff < 1).
##   - No self-feeding loop can create net energy (perpetual motion).
##   - Every fuel-only circuit carries no electrical energy when fuel is gone.
## Returns a list of human-readable violation strings (empty == healthy).

static func validate_network(network: EnergyNetwork) -> Array[String]:
	var violations: Array[String] = []
	if network.nodes.is_empty():
		return violations
	var comps := network.connected_components()
	for comp in comps:
		_validate_component(network, comp, violations)
	return violations


static func _validate_component(network: EnergyNetwork, comp: Array, violations: Array[String]) -> void:
	var effect_info := EnergyGraphEffect.new()
	var producer_w := 0.0
	var consumer_w := 0.0
	var storage_j := 0.0
	var fuel_source := 0.0
	for pos in comp:
		var n: EnergyNode = network.node_at(pos)
		if n == null:
			continue
		match n.kind:
			EnergyNode.Kind.GENERATOR_FUEL:
				producer_w += n.output_w
				# Worst-case fuel burn rate basis: a full oil barrel etc.
				if n.burning:
					fuel_source += n.max_output_w / n.efficiency if n.efficiency > 0.0 else 0.0
			EnergyNode.Kind.GENERATOR_WIND, EnergyNode.Kind.GENERATOR_HYDRO:
				producer_w += n.output_w
				# Wind/hydro kinetic input is sampled, not inventoried.
				effect_info.external_renewables += n.output_w
			EnergyNode.Kind.STORAGE_BATTERY:
				storage_j += n.charge_kj
			EnergyNode.Kind.CONSUMER:
				consumer_w += n.served_w
				effect_info.consumers_w += n.served_w
			EnergyNode.Kind.CABLE, EnergyNode.Kind.SWITCH:
				pass
	if consumer_w > producer_w + storage_j * 1000.0 / maxf(network.TICK_DELTA, 0.001):
		violations.append(
			"CONSERVATION: consumers ask %.1f W > supplied %.1f W + stored %.1f kJ" %
			[consumer_w, producer_w, storage_j])
	# Perpetual-motion check: renewables don't burn anything, fuel generators
	# never create energy from nothing (eff < 1 guarantees out <= in).
	for n_id in effect_info.self_powered:
		violations.append("PERPETUAL: node %s appears self-fed" % str(n_id))


## Extended diagnostic used by design-time checks.
class EnergyGraphEffect extends RefCounted:
	var external_renewables := 0.0
	var consumers_w := 0.0
	var self_powered: Array = []


## Detect any directed cycle in the producer->consumer wiring where a consumer
## feeds back into a producer of the same component (illegal even if it "could"
## work, because the spec forbids self-supplying circuits).
static func find_cycles(network: EnergyNetwork) -> Array:
	var g := network._graph()
	var visited := {}
	var in_stack := {}
	var stack: Array = []
	var cycles: Array = []
	for start in g:
		_dfs_cycle(g, start, visited, in_stack, stack, cycles)
	return cycles


static func _dfs_cycle(g: Dictionary, node, visited: Dictionary, in_stack: Dictionary, stack: Array, cycles: Array) -> void:
	visited[node] = true
	in_stack[node] = true
	stack.append(node)
	for nb in g[node]:
		if not visited.has(nb):
			_dfs_cycle(g, nb, visited, in_stack, stack, cycles)
		elif in_stack.has(nb):
			var idx := stack.find(nb)

	stack.pop_back()
	in_stack.erase(node)","filePath":"/home/work/voxel_survival/scripts/energy/energy_graph_validator.gd"}
